Name: HD Sprites Redux
Author: Shadow00666
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Upscales Stardew Valley's textures to 4x resolution using a  custom pixel-art scaler for  Stardew Valley 1.6 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder
3. Launch the game once through SMAPI
4.when loading your save file it will take sometime so wait patiently 

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Upscales game textures to 4x resolution
- Built-in conditional token system (season, weather, day of week, player state, and more) so texture packs can define variants that swap dynamically as the game changes

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0.0 or later 

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Original mod created by ninthworld (github.com/ninthworld/HDSprites), no longer maintained. This version updates it for 1.6 [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unofficial update (https://github.com/shadow1073/HD-Sprites-unofficial-update-)[/color][/size]
